mutator.name: libredwg_dxf_uaf_llm01_custom_mutator
mutator.strategy: DXF-only weighted custom mutator: preserves default LLVMFuzzerMutate at 50%, and uses three independent ensure_record_structure strategies (random k-th 0-record value-line replacement or constructed OBJECTS section before EOF).

biases.code_hint: locator.section_anchor=OBJECTS; pick random_k code-0 record in section; replace value line only; preserve group-code digits and CRLF; construct OBJECTS section before 0/EOF when absent
same frozen locator/construct as a002; section_anchor is OBJECTS in plan; pick random_k code-0 record; replace value line only
biases.basis: mutations[1].locator/construct; strategy.anchor ENTITIES conflicts with locator.section_anchor OBJECTS

biases.code_hint: same frozen locator/construct as a003; section_anchor is OBJECTS in plan; pick random_k code-0 record; replace value line only
biases.basis: mutations[2].locator/construct; strategy.anchor ACAD_ conflicts with locator.section_anchor OBJECTS

limits: Plan has internal inconsistencies: a002/a003 strategy.anchor are ENTITIES/ACAD_, but their frozen locator.section_anchor and construct.sequence both use OBJECTS. I implemented the frozen locator/construct, so all three actions target OBJECTS; did not invent new section behavior.

Record parsing follows line pairs and supports CRLF/CR/LF; it recognizes numeric group-code lines with leading spaces and up to 5 digits to avoid stopping on 4-digit DXF codes, while preserving original group-code digits.

If a feature path cannot complete (e.g., no code-0 record in the section or MaxSize insufficient for construction), the dispatcher falls back to LLVMFuzzerMutate rather than returning unchanged for absent-section cases.
